spyod pa'i rdo rje 'dus pa gang yin pa de la dad cing de'i lam sgom par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slar gsol pa/ gsum po gang zhig lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dang de bzhin du sbyar te gsung rdo rje dang thugs rdo rje ste de gsum mo/ /de yang le'u dang por bshad pa ltar gsang ba dang 'dus pa'i don rtogs na dad cing sgom pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas skal ba med pa'i phyir ro zhes pa ste/ phyag na rdo rje nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag la bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sngon byung ba na brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i bskal ba yang 'das pa nas/ gang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'das pa nas thub pa chen po 'od srung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i bar gyis kyang theg pa 'di ma gsungs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i gnas kyi don bshad pa de/ de'i tshe de'i dus na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la gsang chen gyi las nyan pa'i snod du ma gyur cing skal ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis sngags kyi theg pa 'di gsungs nas 'das te da lta'i bar bskal chen grangs med gcig dang go gcig song bar bshad do/ /de yang dus 'khor 'grel chen ltar na 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ma gsungs pa yin gyi/ phyogs gzhan du ma gsungs pa min te/ mtshan brjod las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsungs/ ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/

yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhes bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ 'on kyang nas grangs su 'gro'o zhes pa ste/ de ltar yin mod 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba 'dus pa 'di la brten na/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam gyis myur bar sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rdzogs par byed do/ /chu bo chen po gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma'i chu'i rdul du ma ni rdul re re'i grangs ji snyed pa de snyed kyi bskal ba mang bor/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsam pas 'bad cing spyor bas btsal kyang byang chub thob par mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa de/ gsang ba 'dus pa la mngon par dga' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rin po che lta bus snyigs dus kyi tshe gcig po 'di nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa la gsum/ rjes 'jug gi gang zag bzhis 'dus pa'i rgyud ma lus pa nyan yang don ma rtogs par bstan pa'i phyir sngon byung la byang sems rnams bshums pa/ rjes 'jug la rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gis de rnams dbugs 'byin pa bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mya ngan bsal ba'i dris lan/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gis de rnams kyi rab rib bsal bas de dag gis kyang de kho na nyid rtogs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas byang chub nas rab tu dus so zhes pa ste/ de skad ces gsungs pa dang de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis gsung rdo rje'i yi ge'i tshig 'di thos nas rab tu dus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro zhes pa ste/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams ma ngu zhig /lus ngag yid kyi sdug bsngal gsum ma sgoms shig

/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ji ltar mi ngu bar bgyi/ ji ltar sdug bsngal gsum mi bsgom par bgyi/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang ba'i yi ge'i ming tsam thos pa'i skal ba yang ma mchis pas so zhes gsol to/ /gsang ba'i yi ge rdzogs rim rdzogs par skye ba'i skal ba med pa'i don yin gyi/ rgyud kyi tshig rdzogs par ma thos pa min te/ sngar de rdzogs par thos su yod par bstan ma thag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir gsang ba gsum la tshul bzhir bshad de/ le'u dang por bshad zin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de skad ma zer cig /yi ge ni thun mong ba ste/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis ji ltar mi shes pa ste don mngon du ma gyur pa dang*/ ma thos pa ste thos bsam gyis ma shes pa de bzhin du nged de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang rigs kyi bu gsang ba'i yi ge 'di dag ma thos shing mngon par sangs ma rgyas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang ba'i yi ge rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro zhes pa ni don dam la dgongs nas gsungs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas byang chub nas gnas par gyur to zhes pa ste/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad the tshom chod nas cang mi smra bar gnas par gyur to/ /brgyad pa the tshom chod nas nyams su blang pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa la lnga/ thob bya'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i 'od gsal du zhugs pa/ de la lha mo bzhis klus bzhengs par bskul ba/ 'od gsal las bzhengs nas rigs bzhi'i ngo bos spyan sogs dang snyoms par zhugs pa/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje gsum gyi nam mkha'i khams gang bar bstan pa/ ston pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshul lo/

/dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan nas bha ga la zhugs so zhes pa ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga po thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i btsun mo 'od gsal de nyid sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams skye ba'i gzhir gyur pas bha ga ste de la zhugs so ni 'od gsal du zhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de bzhin nas mdzad du gsol zhes pa ste/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi ngo bo rnam snang gi btsun mo sangs rgyas spyan mas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la snyoms par 'jug 'dod kyi dga' bas dbyangs kyis bstod cing bskul ba ni/ sems can khams te dbyings na de'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi bdag nyid du gyur cing*/ gnas te khams gsum gyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal bor gyur pa khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs la dbang du gyur pa brnyes pa'o/ /snyoms 'jug gi dga' ba yid 'ong ba don chen po lhan skyes kyi bde ba de 'dod pas/ de'i ched du bdag la rol bar mdzad pa'i sgo nas bskyab tu gsol/ mgon po zhes bos nas gal te de ring spyan ma bdag ni gson zhing 'tsho bar mchis par bzhed na/ sems can kun gyi yab chen po yin zhing gnyen gyi mchog chen pos bdag la dgyes shing rol par mdzad du gsol/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pa'i btsun mo mā ma kis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la rdo rje 'dod pa'i dga' ba'i mchod pa'i mchog khyad par 'phags pa'i yi ge'i tshig 'dis yang dag par bstod cing bskul lo/ /'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du gnas pa'i rdo rje'i sku khyod ni bka' yi 'khor lo chos ston pa'i sgo nas sems can kun la phan par mdzad la/

sangs rgyas ni phung po lnga ste/ de rnams kyi shin tu phra ba'i don ni sgyu ma'i sku'o/ /byang chub ni 'od gsal dang*/ de'i don dam pa ni zung 'jug gi sku ste de sems can la rjes su phan par dgongs nas ston pa'o/ /mgon po gal te sogs sngar ltar la/ 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags rnams par spyod pa'i sgo nas dam tshig chags pas bdag la dga' bas dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyi bdag po 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i spyan gos dkar mo can gyis/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la 'dod pa nye bar longs spyod pa'i tshig gis yang dag par bstod pa/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste ngag gi dbang phyug brnyes pas sems can kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba chen po dang ldan la/ tshad med bzhis 'jig rten gyi sems can dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la dus rtag tu brtson pa ste/ mgon po sogs sngar ltar ro/ /rab tu dga' ba'i spyod pa kun tu bzang bos bdag la dgyes shing rol par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo dam tshig gi rdo rje don grub kyi btsun mo sgrol mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la de'i bde ba dang yid bde ba'i dga' ba bskyed pa'i tshig 'dir yang dag par bstod cing bskul lo/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa ste rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba las lha'i tshogs sprul te sems kyi zhe sdang sogs spyod zhing*/ las kyi rigs thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pas na dam tshig mchog go /'dod chags la spyod pa'i sems can rnams 'dod chags lam du byas pa'i tshul gyis spyod zhing 'od gsal gyi ye shes stsol bas na phan pa'i don chen po mdzad do/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog ni bu ram shing ba'i gdung brgyud shākya'i rigs las 'khrungs pa'o/

/yang na bya grub kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pas na rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog go /rang gzhan ngo bos grub pa'i tha dad du zhen pa dang bral zhing nye ring med par mnyam pa nyid du gzigs pa ste/ mgon po sogs sngar ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i yon tan rin po che mang po'i gter du gyur pa khyod kyis bdag la dgyes shing rol par mdzad du gsol lo/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan nas mi gsung bar gyur to zhes pa ste/ de nas ston pa 'od gsal las bzhengs nas mdzad pa bstan pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa rig ma'i gzugs sogs la longs spyod pas na 'dod par bya ba thams cad la longs spyod pa'i rdo rje'i dpal bde stong la rol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs bzhi po thams cad kyi btsun mo de dag la dam tshig gi 'khor lo ste rnam snang sogs rigs bzhi'i ngo bo 'dod pa spyod cing cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas nam mkha'i dbyings nas gnas par gyur to zhes pa te/ de ltar phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs pas nam mkha'i dbyings 'di dag thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig gi khu ba ste rnam snang la sogs pa'i lha'i 'khor los yongs su gang ste/ 'dod pa thams cad rdzogs par byed pa'i bum pa bzang po rdo rje'i chus gang ba ltar bar mtshams med par gang zhing gnas par gyur to/ /lnga pa la bzhi/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis sems can rnams la dbang bskur bas de rnams kyang kun tu bzang po'i ming can du gyur pa/ sems can rnams kun du bzang por mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa 'khor rnams kyis gzigs tshul/ de la 'khor rnams ngo mtshar skyes nas zhus pa/ 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid yin pa tsam la ngo mtshar che rgyu med par bstan pa'o/

/dang po ni/ de nas rdo rje nam mkha'i nas dbang bskur bar gyur to zhes pa ste/ rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings ni khams gsum gyi gnas te 'di na gnas pa'i sems can rnams sku gsum gyi ngo bo'i dam tshig go /de las yang dag par byung ba ni rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nyid do/ /rdo rje dpal te byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis reg pas de nas sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes can du gyur to/ /de nas brtsams te sems can de thams cad kun tu bzang po kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i ming can du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rjes dbang bskur bar gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas mthong lags so zhes pa ste/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ston pa phyag na rdo rjes 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid mthong ngam/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyag na rdo rje ste ston la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje ye shes kyi spyod pa ji ltar bstan pa bdag cag gis mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas ngo mtshar to zhes pa ste/ de nas 'khor gyi bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i bha ga 'od gsal du zhugs pa las mngon par byung ste langs nas/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang chen po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis na 'dod chags kyi yi ge'i tshig gis bstan pa'i 'dod chags kyi spyod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang rjes su rtogs pa ste thob par 'gyur pa de ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/

/bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas mi gsung bar gyur to zhes pa ste/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa khyed thams cad de skad ces ma zer cig /rgyu mtshan de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i rdo rje 'chang gi dam tshig dang mtshungs pa'i phyir chags sogs rnams la de kho na nyid la dpyod pa'i rigs pas dpyad na de rnams ni gzugs kyi phung po ma yin/ tshor ba'i phung po ma yin/ 'du shes kyi phung po ma yin/ 'du byed kyi phung po ma yin/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po ma yin/ khams bco brgyad po gang yang ma yin/ skye mched bcu gnyis kyang ma yin/ de bzhin du 'dir 'dod chags ma yin zhe sdang ma yin gti mug ma yin chos ma yin chos ma yin pa yang ma yin te/ btags don rigs pas btsal ba'i tshe mi rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar 'dod chags sogs kyi de kho na nyid rtogs pas byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'i tshul bstan pas/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad cang mi gsung bar de kho na nyid bsam pa'i sgo nas bzhugs so/ /dgu pa rgyud yongs su gtad pa la gsum/ 'dus pa sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la spyir gtang ba/ bye brag tu rdo rje chos la gtad de zhal gyi bzhes pa/ gtad pa'i 'og tu 'khor rnams rdo rje gsum du gyur par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas skal ba yod pa'i phyir ro zhes pa ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' de rnam la bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di bsgo bar gyis pa ste/

'dzin du chug cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la skal ba yod pa ste ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes pa ste/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas rdo rje chos gsang ba'i bdag po la bka' stsal ba rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa 'da' bar mi bya ba'i bdag nyid can 'di zungs shig khyod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad la dbang phyug tu gyur pa'i rdo rje zhes dbang bskur bar gnang ngo*/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje chos kyis bka' stsal pa de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes gsol nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes pa ste/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma dang khro bo la sogs pa rnams te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge gsum la rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs zhugs par gyur to ni de thams cad kyis kyang rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang mngon du byas pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad khams gsum gyi sems can rnams kyi lus kyi rdo rje de kho na nyid dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i tshul du gnas shing de dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ky-i sku rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi dag gi rdo rje de kho na nyid la gnas shing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/

/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rdo rje phyag na rdo rje ste rdo rje 'chang nyid khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rdo rje de kho na nyid la gnas shing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs mnyam pa nyid la sngar ltar dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /bzhi pa mjug sdud pa ni/ de skad ces bka' stsal to zhes pa ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di de skad ces bka' stsal to zhes so/ / gnyis pa mtshan don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o zhes pa'i bar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba ste rdo rje gsum gtso bor byas nas gcig tu gyur pas/ gsang ba gsum po bsdus nas ston pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'dus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga po thams cad kyi dam tshig nyams su blang bar bya ba'i don bsrung ba dang bza' ba dang bsten pa rnams dang sdom pa ni de rnams nan tan du sgrub pa'o/ /rigs lngas bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams ni 'da' bar mi bya bas na rdo rje ste mi phyed pa'o/ /de'i byin gyis brlabs kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'i 'grel pa'o/ /bzhi pa mjug gi don ni/ rgya gar gyi mkhan poshra dhā ka ra warma te dad byed go cha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī dz+nyā na ka ra ste dpal ye shes byed pas bshad nas/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis zhus gtugs g.yar khral lam kha khral du 'tshal ba ste bgyis so/ /slar yang paṇ+ḍi ta nag po'i zhabs kyis bshad nas 'gos nyid kyi 'gyur bcos mdzad do/ /smras pa/ dbyangs dang gsal byed yi ge so gsum gyi/ /mtha' can rgyud de stong phrag so gsum dang*/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di'o/

/'di yi dgongs 'grel 'chad nyan phyogs gcig tsam/ /'dzin gang de yang rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /'dra bar bltas nas phyag bya'i gnas nyid du/ /gsungs na tshul bzhin sgrub rnams lta ci smos/ /sngon tshe thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /lus rten mchog dman grangs med brgyud gyur kyang*/ /'di 'dra'i zab mo'i rgyud kyi dgongs 'grel ba'i/ / skal ba ldan zhig byung ngam byung min tsho/ /da lta bla ma'i legs bshad mig sman gyi/ /blo chung bdag lta'i blo mig rab rib dag /bsal bas rgyud don khong na gnas pa'ang*/ /cung zad mthong bas dga' dad spu long g.yos/ /de phyir klu sgrub dpal ldan zla ba dang*/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ / dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud yongs rdzogs kyi/ /tshig don ji nus blo dang 'tsham par bkral/ /'di la sger kyi khyad chos gzhan dka' yang*/ /rgyud kyi sa bcad so so'i gzhung rnams kyi/ /thog mtha' bzung ba'i tshul gyis gsal bkod pa/ /de ni 'grel ba 'di yi khyad par ro/ /tshur mthong blo mig mi gsal zab mo'i don/ /ma bshad log bshad nyes kun bdag gi ste/ /legs par bshad pa'i cha shas ji yod pa/ /de ni lha dang bla ma'i drin las yin/ /tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad las byung ba'i dge /ji snyed mchis des tshe rab kun du bdag /zab mo'i lam mchog 'di dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /myur du rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka yongs su rdzogs pa 'di ni/ mdo sngags dang tha snyad kyi rig gnas du ma la mkhyen pa rgyas shing*/ lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas phyogs 'dir mdo sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mkhas dbang ko'u shi nang so yes kyis/ rang phyogs co ne dgon du mdo sngags kyi bshad grwa gnyis gsar du btsugs pa'i nang tshan rgyud pa grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan gyi rgyun la phan srid par dgongs nas/ gnang sbyin dang bcas te bkas bskul ba ltar/

rgyud pa'i slob dpon pa shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas/ 7 /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgya mtsho dang blo bzang sbyin pa sogs kyi bka' drin la brten nas rtsa rgyud 'grel ba mtha' dpyod bsdus don dang bcas pa dang*/ 'di skor gyi gzhung du ma la 'dris shing don phal cher khong du chud pa byas nas/ bshad rgyud kyi don 'grel ba las 'phros pa 'ga' zhig mang du dogs shing*/ 'grel pa nas 'byung ba'i bsdus don dang rgyan gyi skor bshad thabs dang bcas pa zhig ni bdag gis logs su bris zin pas 'dir yang bzhag ste/ rtsa rgyud nyid kyi tshig don 'di ltar sa bcad 'grel pa mchan bu dang bcas pa dang bstun nas bgyis pa'i tshe/ sngags ram pa kun dga' chos 'byung dang*/ byams pa rin chen dang*/ kun dga' chos ldan gsum gyis rgyud grwa nas mtshan bdag mdzad pa'i tshe par du brkos pa ste/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang*/ khyad par 'dus pa'i bstan pa phyogs kun du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi ṭik+ka bde ba'i lam bzang snying po bsdus pa'i chu klung blo gsal gdung 'phrog bzhugs/ - PAGE 34-- PAGE 411- -PAGE 33--
